_doc: 畫風預設集（N5）。project.yaml 的 style_preset 選一組；明寫的 style／meta／look 蓋掉該欄位。look 只給文字端提示詞用，style／meta／sfx 給生圖。

mono.name: 日式黑白頁漫
mono.style: Black and white Japanese manga artwork, clean confident ink lineart, screentone shading, high contrast, no color
mono.sfx: Bold hand-drawn manga sound effect lettering in black ink.

color.name: 彩色日式頁漫
color.style: Full color Japanese manga artwork, clean confident lineart, vivid cel shading, soft rim light, rich saturated palette
color.sfx: Bold hand-drawn manga sound effect lettering with flat colored fill and dark outline.

american.name: 美式彩色漫畫
american.style: American comic book illustration, bold dynamic inking, dramatic light and shadow, halftone shading, full color
american.sfx: Bold comic book sound effect lettering with colored fill and heavy dark outline.
